latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Capacitor App Development skill.

- Provides structured guidance for general Capacitor app development topics, including core concepts, configuration, platform management, security, and troubleshooting.
- Includes a topic index with mapped reference files for quick navigation.
- Details agent behavior for project auto-detection, topic routing, and actionable, step-by-step instructions.
- Specifies prerequisites and error handling best practices.
- Clarifies out-of-scope topics, with redirects to related specialized skills as needed.
